key_insight: Color fundus photography AI has evolved from separate dataset, preprocessing, and model advances into a unified multimodal pipeline that links images with EHRs and longitudinal patient data.
clinical_relevance: This integrated approach could improve large-scale screening, cross-domain generalization, and more comprehensive clinical reasoning from routine retinal imaging.
method: Reviewed the co-evolution of CFP datasets, preprocessing strategies, and modeling frameworks.
Traced the shift from CNNs to foundation models, state space models, and multimodal expert architectures.
Highlighted preprocessing advances such as neural data engineering, token optimization, and EHR imputation.
evidence_signal: The abstract synthesizes trends across small single-center datasets and newer multi-center resources with multimodal pairings and longitudinal clinical records.
watch_item: Multimodal deployment will still depend on data quality, interoperability, and careful validation across sites and patient populations.
paper_title: Color Fundus Photography Analysis: Co-evolution of Data, Preprocessing, and Modeling toward Multimodal AI
